instruction.text: Im Wortgitter sind fünf Dinge versteckt, die positive oder negative Einflüsse auf die Umwelt haben. Tippe sie an.

hint.text: Folgende Wörter sind gesucht: plastic, recycling, cars, planes, rubbish.

hint.text: Saisonal bedeutet, dass Lebensmittel in der aktuellen Jahreszeit geerntet werden. Regional bedeutet, dass sie aus der Region stammen.

instruction.text: Welches Verhalten ist besser für die Umwelt? Wähle aus.

b: You should always leave the heating on.
++You should turn off the heating when you are not at home.
++It's better to take a short shower instead of a bath because then you use less water.
Taking a bath every day is a good way to protect the environment.
++Eating little or no meat is good for the environment.
Eating lots of meat is good for the environment.
It's bad for the environment to recycle or separate rubbish.
++You should always try to recycle and separate rubbish.
++It's better to wash clothes only when the washing machine is full to save water.
You should turn on the washing machine every day even if it isn't full.

instruction.text: Vervollständige diese weiteren Tipps zum Umweltschutz, indem du die passenden Satzenden auswählst.

atoms.b: It's good to turn off the tap if ((++you_don't_need_it_anymore. you_want_to_wash_your_hands.))
To save electricity, you should ((++turn_off_the_lights turn_on_every_lamp)) when no one is in the room.
Only throw away food if it is ((good ++bad)).
Eating regional food is ((++better_for_the_environment bad_for_the_environment)) because of the shorter transportation routes.
It is ((++good_for_the_environment bad_for_the_supermarket)) to use reusable batteries.
